Introduction
============

The BMW Service Centre Capacity Intelligence project is designed to improve the operational efficiency
of BMW dealerships by identifying service centres that are overloaded, underutilized, or operating at
optimal capacity.

The solution combines multiple layers of the modern data stack:

- data ingestion and cleaning with Python and PySpark
- cloud storage in Amazon S3
- analytics in Amazon Athena
- infrastructure automation with Terraform
- business dashboards in Amazon QuickSight

Business Problem
----------------

BMW operates service centres across multiple regions, and workload distribution is often uneven.
This creates operational issues such as:

- long customer wait times
- underutilized facilities
- inefficient staffing and resource allocation
- rising operational costs

Project Objectives
------------------

The platform helps BMW operations teams to:

- monitor dealer utilization
- detect overloaded service centres
- identify underutilized locations
- compare service patterns across regions
- reduce operational inefficiency
- improve decision-making with KPI-driven reporting
